verdict.rationale: Phaser is itself an official, first-party library you build against. It installs via `npm install phaser`, is also served from the jsDelivr CDN, and ships full TypeScript definitions that editors detect automatically. An official CLI scaffolds projects from official templates, and a runtime probe confirms the package is live on npm (v4.2.1, MIT, ~263k weekly downloads). Older community complaints about TypeScript typings predate these documented bundled types and do not concretely contradict them. missing for 10: official SDKs beyond JavaScript/TypeScript, and independent hands-on corroboration of the current TypeScript SDK quality.
